voice-translate.engine.explain: Runs on this computer: private, free and accurate. Parakeet understands 25 European languages and keeps up on any processor; the Whisper models know 99 languages and want an NVIDIA card. Downloads about %s MB once, shared by every Minecraft instance. Nothing is installed system-wide.
voice-translate.engine.installed_chat: Voice Translate: the speech engine is installed.
voice-translate.engine.failed_chat: Voice Translate: the speech engine could not be installed. The reason is in the Speech tab.
voice-translate.hint.google: Works without a key. For more natural translations of slang and game talk, choose the AI model.
voice-translate.hint.deepl: A free key at deepl.com covers 500,000 characters a month. If DeepL fails, Google fills in.
voice-translate.hint.llm: The model keeps Minecraft terms, slang and tone, reads the previous lines for context and fixes misheard words. If it fails, Google fills in.

voice-translate.settings.enabled.desc: Subtitles for what other players say in voice chat
voice-translate.settings.target_language: The language subtitles are written in. "Game language" follows Minecraft's language setting
voice-translate.settings.spoken_language: Leave on detect unless everyone on the server speaks one language: fixing it makes short phrases more accurate
voice-translate.settings.show_untranslat: Also show subtitles for players who already speak your language
voice-translate.settings.recognition.des: On this computer is private and free; Groq is as accurate and needs no graphics card
voice-translate.settings.model.desc: Parakeet: 25 European languages, quick on any processor. Whisper: 99 languages, bigger is more accurate and slower
voice-translate.settings.device.desc: For Whisper models. The graphics card is many times faster; the processor works on any computer
voice-translate.settings.pause.desc: Shorter gives subtitles sooner; longer keeps a slow speaker's sentence in one piece
voice-translate.settings.sensitivity.des: How much louder than their background noise a player must be to count as speaking. Raise it for noisy microphones
voice-translate.settings.translator.desc: Google needs no key; DeepL and an AI model translate more naturally
voice-translate.settings.bubbles.desc: A subtitle above the speaker's head while they are on screen
voice-translate.settings.panel.desc: The panel shows players you cannot see: behind you, far away or in a group call
voice-translate.settings.show_original.d: The recognised speech, smaller, under the translation
voice-translate.settings.drafts.desc: Show a sentence while it is still being spoken. Local engine only
voice-translate.settings.chat_log.desc: Also write every finished translation into the chat
voice-translate.status.where_to_find: This window also opens from the Simple Voice Chat menu (the speech bubble icon) and from the Addons tab in Plasmo Voice's settings.
voice-translate.hint.custom_server: Any server with an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint, such as speaches or faster-whisper-server.
voice-translate.glossary.ready: English speech uses the game's own names for %s items, blocks, mobs and biomes in your language, so "nether" stays the Nether.
voice-translate.glossary.none: The game's names are used when translating English into another language; there is nothing to look up for the current target.
voice-translate.players.hint: Players switched off here are not recognised at all, which also saves your computer the work.
voice-translate.settings.own_voice.desc: Translate your own microphone as well, so you can try the mod alone. Turn it off for normal play
voice-translate.status.heard.nobody: No voices heard yet. Your own voice is not translated unless you turn on "My voice too" on the General tab.
voice-translate.models.stored: On disk (GB): %s. Green in the model button means downloaded.
voice-translate.tab.voice.desc: Spoken translations: other players dubbed, and your speech sent in another language
voice-translate.settings.dub_others.desc: Read every translation aloud from the speaker, while their own voice gets quieter
voice-translate.settings.clone_voices.de: Turn the Piper voice into each player's own, copied from a few seconds of their speech. Needs the voice copying engine below
voice-translate.settings.original_volume: How loud a dubbed player's own voice stays
voice-translate.settings.my_speech.desc: Others hear your speech in another language a moment after you stop talking
voice-translate.hint.my_speech: While you talk nothing is sent; when you stop, the phrase is translated and sent, so others hear it a second or two later. They need nothing installed. If translation fails, your original phrase is sent.
voice-translate.voice.explain: OpenVoice on the processor, no graphics card needed: a sentence takes about a second, so copied dubs come a moment after plain ones. Downloads about %s MB once, about 1.7 GB on disk. Every copied voice carries WavMark, an inaudible watermark that marks it as generated; nobody hears it. Without the engine, or while it is busy, the plain Piper voice speaks.
voice-translate.my_speech.off: Your speech is sent as it is
voice-translate.voice_engine.unsupported: The voice copying engine cannot be installed on this system.
voice-translate.voice_engine.not_install: The voice copying engine is not installed.
voice-translate.voice_engine.stopped: The voice copying engine is installed and starts when needed.
voice-translate.voice_engine.remove_conf: Click again to delete it with its model
voice-translate.voice_engine.installed_c: Voice Translate: voice copying is installed.
voice-translate.voice_engine.failed_chat: Voice Translate: voice copying could not be installed. The reason is in the Voice tab.
voice-translate.engine.gpu_libraries: Whisper models run on the processor here. Your NVIDIA card can run them many times faster once NVIDIA's libraries are added, about 1.2 GB. Parakeet does not need them.
voice-translate.engine.ready_voices: Ready to speak; speech is recognised in the cloud
voice-translate.voice.piper: Spoken by Piper voices from the speech engine, a male or female one to match each player: about 60 MB per language, downloaded when first needed, quick on any processor. 37 languages, Ukrainian and Kazakh among them; Japanese and Korean stay subtitles.
voice-translate.voice.needs_engine: Spoken translations need the speech engine. Install it on the Speech tab, even if you recognise speech in the cloud.
voice-translate.guide.title: Voice Translate: how to use it
voice-translate.guide.welcome.heading: What this mod does
voice-translate.guide.welcome.what: When other players talk in voice chat (Simple Voice Chat or Plasmo Voice), this mod writes what they say in your language. Like subtitles in a film: above the speaker's head and at the bottom of the screen.
voice-translate.guide.welcome.nobody_els: Nobody else has to install anything, and neither does the server. It all works on your computer only.
voice-translate.guide.welcome.once: You set it up once, it takes a couple of minutes. Press Next.
voice-translate.guide.engine.heading: Download speech recognition
voice-translate.guide.engine.why: To understand what someone said, the mod needs a program on your computer. Press the button below; it downloads about 1 GB once.
voice-translate.guide.engine.press: You can press Next right away and even go and play: the download carries on by itself, and the chat tells you when it is ready.
voice-translate.guide.engine.any_compute: No graphics card needed, it works on any computer. Voices never leave your computer; only the recognised text goes to the translator.
voice-translate.guide.language.heading: Which language to translate into
voice-translate.guide.language.usually: Usually that is your game's language, and then there is nothing to change here.
voice-translate.guide.language.theirs: The language other players speak is found out by itself. You do not need to set it.
voice-translate.guide.check.heading: Check that it works
voice-translate.guide.check.join: Join a server with voice chat. When someone talks, the translation appears above their head a second later.
voice-translate.guide.check.status: The lines below show what is happening right now. If something is wrong, they say what.
voice-translate.guide.check.later: Later the settings open with the J key, the button in Simple Voice Chat's menu, or the Addons tab in Plasmo Voice's settings.
voice-translate.guide.voice.heading: Optional: hear translations instead of reading
voice-translate.guide.voice.optional: You can leave this alone. Both switches are off unless you turn them on.
voice-translate.guide.voice.dub_others: You hear every translation spoken from the player who said it, and their real voice gets quieter.
voice-translate.guide.voice.my_speech: Other players hear you in another language. While you talk nothing is sent; your phrase goes out a couple of seconds after you stop.
voice-translate.guide.voice.more: Which language, how loud, and copying players' own voices are on the Voice tab.
